name: Korea Tourism Organization TourAPI
notes: Use EngService2/searchFestival2 for English event data. Add Kor/Jpn/Chs/Cht/Spn/Rus language services as needed.

name: VISITKOREA
notes: Use official articles as source links; write original summaries instead of copying full text.

name: Korea Grand Sale / Visit Korea Committee
notes: Seasonal anchor source for winter shopping tourism pages.

name: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism
notes: Use for validation when a tourism campaign is government-backed.

name: Culture Portal API
notes: Best fit for performances and exhibitions that are not covered by TourAPI.

name: KMA ASOS Daily Weather API
notes: Use to calculate same-period previous-year weather notes per city.

name: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar
notes: Strong official source for Seoul event dates, venues, admission notes, and official event websites.

name: Seoul Grand Park
owner: Seoul Grand Park / Seoul Metropolitan Government
refreshCadence: weekly; daily during flower festival seasons
notes: Use for Seoul Grand Park program dates and status labels. Main page can expose current and recently ended events.

name: SHOWALA exhibition listing
notes: Use as an exhibition listing source only; confirm with the event website when it contains current-year details.

name: OLIVE YOUNG Global
notes: Some offers are country-specific and app-only; always show eligibility warnings.

name: The Shilla Duty Free
notes: Store numbers and branch restrictions need human-readable mapping before publication.

name: Lotte Duty Free
notes: Duty-free rules depend on itinerary, product category, and departure airport.

name: Lotte Duty Free Online Sale
refreshCadence: daily; hourly during peak travel sale windows
notes: Use as a deal discovery signal; verify stock, eligibility, pickup rules, and active date range before publishing.

name: Lotte Department Store Global
refreshCadence: daily for Seoul and Busan flagship branches
notes: Good official source for flagship branch hours, shopping news links, foreign visitor benefits, and tax refund guidance.

name: Hyundai Department Store
notes: Branch pages often reveal events earlier than English travel sites.

name: Shinsegae Duty Free
notes: Official event list exposes branch date ranges; language selector is available on page.

name: Shinsegae Duty Free English Events
notes: Use the English event list when available, but compare against the Korean/Japanese pages when date ranges differ.

name: Shinsegae Group Newsroom
notes: Official press feed for Shinsegae Department Store, Shinsegae Duty Free, outlets, pop-ups, and foreign visitor promotions.

name: Weverse Shop Notices
notes: Use only official notices and artist/company channels; avoid unverified fan rumors.

name: Weverse Shop BTS Notices
refreshCadence: daily; hourly around comebacks and tours
notes: Use list pages for discovery and individual official notices for final source links.

name: Official artist/company social channels
refreshCadence: hourly when tracked artist list is active
notes: Instagram/X/fanclub notices are scattered. Queue links for human review before publishing.
